draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.00, the 135th-best grade among 257 2026 draftees and 21st of 36 at WR. He lasted until pick 191, well after his grade rank (135th): he slid relative to the published grade. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 872 receiving yards in 2025, 14th of 36 WRs in his class with stats.
